title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Installment Arrangements: Returned Payments on the Enrollment
content:
Under the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, the returned-payment term of an installment arrangement takes installments away according to the family payments on the enrollment that the bank returned within a 12-month window. A return counts when it posted after the same day of the month 12 months before the day of the payment, and on or before the day of the payment. When that earlier month has no such day, the last day of that month is used.

| Family payments on the enrollment returned within that window | Installments taken away |
|---|---|
| two or more | 2 |
| exactly one | 1 |
| none | none |

The returned payments counted are the returned-payment entries on this earlier-year enrollment's own billing history. A return posted on or before the same day of the month 12 months earlier does not count, and neither does a return on another enrollment of the household.

**Examples (hypothetical payment day of August 26).** One returned check on the enrollment posted the previous December, and another the previous March. Both fall within the window, so 2 installments are taken away. A single return posted August 26 of the previous year, the same day of the month 12 months before, is not counted, and no installment is taken away. A return posted on August 26 itself, the day of the payment, is counted.
